tests.name: StoryAnalysisPackage_WhenImported_OwnsDomainBehavior
tests.description: Story Analysis workflow, engine, escalation, grading, and workflow logging are importable from the workflow-owned package and retain existing behavior.
tests.arrange: Existing orchestrator domain tests and Story Analysis package
tests.act: Import domain symbols from story_analysis_workflow and run the migrated unit suite
tests.assert: Behavior remains green without importing domain implementations from orchestrator

tests.name: StoryAnalysisActivities_WhenMigrated_PreserveArtifactFallback
tests.description: The complete Activity folder and adjacent configurations are workflow-owned and preserve artifact fallback behavior.
tests.arrange: Existing Activity tests, common SkillActivity lifecycle, and colocated JSON configuration
tests.act: Run migrated Activity tests against story_analysis_workflow.activities
tests.assert: All Activities retain wire names, configuration, sentinel handling, and fallback output resolution

tests.name: StoryAnalysisClients_WhenMigrated_UseOwnedContractsAndCommonLogging
tests.description: Starter, CLI, signals, queries, and diagnostic client use workflow-owned contracts and common logging.
tests.arrange: Existing Story Analysis client tests and centralized wire constants
tests.act: Run client unit tests after replacing orchestrator imports
tests.assert: Public client behavior and wire names remain unchanged with no Story Analysis dependency on orchestrator

tests.name: StoryAnalysisModule_WhenRegistered_DeclaresAccurateSpec
tests.description: The package exports an immutable WorkflowModuleSpec and registers every declared workflow and Activity using existing wire names.
tests.arrange: A fresh Cadence Registry and the story_analysis_workflow module entry point
tests.assert: SPEC declares the domain, task list, workflow type, Activity types, and callable registration accurately

tests.name: StoryAnalysisPackage_WhenImportsAnalyzed_RespectsLayerBoundary
tests.description: The workflow package imports common and its own modules but not orchestrator or another workflow package.
tests.assert: No disallowed package dependency is present and no stale Story Analysis implementation remains in orchestrator
